aboriginal.definition: An animal or plant native to a region.

administration.definition: The act of administering; government of public affairs; the service rendered, or duties assumed, in conducting affairs; the conducting of any office or employment; direction.

air.definition: The substance constituting Earth's atmosphere: a gaseous mixture of nitrogen, oxygen, and various trace gases.

alga.definition: Any of many aquatic photosynthetic organisms, including the seaweeds, whose size ranges from a single cell to giant kelps and whose biochemistry and forms are very diverse, some being eukaryotic.

alphabet.definition: The set of letters used when writing in a language.

amine.definition: A functional group formally derived from ammonia by replacing one, two or three hydrogen atoms with hydrocarbon or other radicals.

amnion.definition: The innermost membrane of the fetal membranes of reptiles, birds, and mammals; the sac in which the embryo is suspended.

ancient.definition: A person who is very old.

animal.definition: A multicellular organism of the kingdom Animalia that is usually mobile, with cells that are not encased in a rigid cell wall (distinguishing them from plants and fungi) and derives energy solely from the consumption of other organisms.

apple.definition: A common, firm, round fruit produced by a tree of the genus Malus.

area.definition: A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units.

attack.definition: An attempt to cause damage, injury to, or death of an opponent or enemy. Any of several specific maneuvers, skills, or special abilities that a character can use to inflict damage against opponents.

audible.definition: The act of or an instance of changing the play at the line of scrimmage by yelling out a new one.

aura.definition: A subtle emanation or exhalation of any substance, such as an aroma or odour.

axis.definition: An imaginary line around which an object spins (an axis of rotation) or is symmetrically arranged (an axis of symmetry).

back.definition: The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.

barium.definition: The chemical element (symbol Ba) with an atomic number of 56. It is a soft, reactive, silvery alkaline earth metal.

base.definition: Something from which other things extend; a foundation. A supporting, lower or bottom component of a structure or object.

bat.definition: Any flying mammal of the order Chiroptera, usually small and nocturnal, insectivorous or frugivorous.

be.definition: The name of the Cyrillic script letter Б / б

bird.definition: An animal of the clade (traditionally class) Aves in the phylum Chordata, characterized by being warm-blooded, having feathers and wings usually capable of flight, having a beaked mouth, and laying eggs.

birth.definition: The process of childbearing; the beginning of life; the emergence of a human baby or other viviparous animal offspring from the mother's body into the environment.

blood.definition: A vital liquid flowing in the bodies of many types of animals that usually conveys nutrients and oxygen. In vertebrates, it is colored red by hemoglobin, is conveyed by arteries and veins, is pumped by the heart and is usually generated in bone marrow.

bole.definition: The trunk or stem of a tree.

bone.definition: A composite material consisting largely of calcium phosphate and collagen and making up the skeleton of most vertebrates.

boom.definition: A low-pitched, resonant sound, such as of an explosion.

boron.definition: The chemical element (symbol B) with an atomic number of 5, which is a metalloid found in its pure form as a dark amorphous powder. An atom of this element.

branch.definition: The woody part of a tree arising from the trunk and usually dividing.

brine.definition: Salt water; water saturated or strongly impregnated with salt; a salt-and-water solution for pickling.

burning.definition: The act by which something burns or is burned.

buttock.definition: Each of the two large fleshy halves of the posterior part of the body between the base of the back, the perineum, and the top of the legs.

calf.definition: A young cow or bull of any bovid, such as domestic cattle or buffalo.

category.definition: A group, often named or numbered, to which items are assigned based on similarity or defined criteria.

cerium.definition: A chemical element (symbol Ce) with an atomic number of 58, a very soft, ductile, silvery-white metal that tarnishes when exposed to air.

character.definition: A being involved in the action of a story; a persona.

characteristic.definition: A distinguishing feature of a person or thing, a part of mental or physical behavior.

cheek.definition: The soft skin on each side of the face, below the eyes; the outer surface of the sides of the oral cavity.

citizen.definition: A resident of a city or town, especially one with legally recognized rights or duties.

city.definition: A large settlement, bigger than a town; sometimes with a specific legal definition, depending on the place.

comedy.definition: a choric song of celebration or revel, especially in Ancient Greece

compound.definition: An enclosure within which workers, prisoners, or soldiers are confined.

concerning.definition: That which one is concerned in; one's business.

cone.definition: A surface of revolution formed by rotating a segment of a line around another line that intersects the first line.

country.definition: The territory of a nation; a sovereign state or a region once independent and still distinct in institutions, language, etc.

countryside.definition: An area located outside of towns and cities; an area that is not urban or suburban; a rural area.

court.definition: An enclosed space; a courtyard; an uncovered area shut in by the walls of a building, or by different buildings; also, a space opening from a street and nearly surrounded by houses; a blind alley.

coxite.definition: Either of a pair of lamellate structures on the underside of each abdominal segment in certain insects.

culture.definition: The arts, customs, lifestyles, background, and habits that characterize humankind, or a particular society or nation.

current.definition: The generally unidirectional movement of a gas or fluid.

day.definition: The time when the Sun is above the horizon and it lights the sky.

death.definition: The cessation of life and all associated processes; the end of an organism's existence as an entity independent from its environment and its return to an inert, non-living state.

deism.definition: A philosophical belief in the existence of a god (or goddess) knowable through human reason; especially, a belief in a creator god unaccompanied by any belief in supernatural phenomena or specific religious doctrines.

deme.definition: A township or other subdivision of ancient Attica.

descent.definition: An instance of descending; act of coming down.

development.definition: The process of developing; growth, directed change.

dew.definition: Any moisture from the atmosphere condensed by cool bodies upon their surfaces.

diazonium.definition: any univalent cation, of general formula R-N2; diazonium salts are used to manufacture azo dyes, and take part in the Sandmeyer reaction

differ.definition: A program that diffs, a diff.

doctrine.definition: A belief or tenet, especially about philosophical or theological matters.

dome.definition: A structural element resembling the hollow upper half of a sphere.

dower.definition: The part of or interest in a deceased husband's property provided to his widow, usually in the form of a life estate.

drama.definition: A composition, normally in prose, telling a story and intended to be represented by actors impersonating the characters and speaking the dialogue.

duke.definition: The male ruler of a duchy (female equivalent: duchess).

dura mater.definition: The tough and inflexible outermost of the three layers of the meninges, enveloping the brain and spinal cord.

dye.definition: A colorant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied.

ear.definition: The organ of hearing, consisting of the pinna or auricle, auditory canal, eardrum, malleus, incus, stapes and cochlea.

early.definition: A shift (scheduled work period) that takes place early in the day.

element.definition: One of the simplest or essential parts or principles of which anything consists, or upon which the constitution or fundamental powers of anything are based.

elm.definition: A tree of the genus Ulmus of the family Ulmaceae, large deciduous trees with alternate stipulate leaves and small apetalous flowers.

eye.definition: An organ through which animals see (“perceive surroundings via light”).

family.definition: A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; in particular, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.

fandom.definition: The fans of a sport, activity, work, person etc., taken as a group.

farm.definition: A place where agricultural and similar activities take place, especially the growing of crops or the raising of livestock.

fashion.definition: A current (constantly changing) trend, favored for frivolous rather than practical, logical, or intellectual reasons.

fear.definition: A strong, unpleasant emotion or feeling caused by actual or perceived danger or threat.

feces.definition: Digested waste material (that is typically solid or semisolid) that is discharged from a human or other animal's stomach to the intestines through the anus.

felt.definition: A cloth or stuff made of matted fibres of wool, or wool and fur, fulled or wrought into a compact substance by rolling and pressure, with lees or size, without spinning or weaving.

fermentation.definition: Any of many anaerobic biochemical reactions in which an enzyme (or several enzymes produced by a microorganism) catalyses the conversion of one substance into another; especially the conversion (using yeast) of sugars to alcohol or acetic acid with the evolution of carbon dioxide

fern.definition: Any of a group of some twenty thousand species of vascular plants classified in the division Pteridophyta that lack seeds and reproduce by shedding spores to initiate an alternation of generations.

fetus.definition: An unborn or unhatched vertebrate showing signs of the mature animal.

fiction.definition: Literary type using invented or imaginative writing, instead of real facts, usually written as prose.

fire.definition: A (usually self-sustaining) chemical reaction involving the bonding of oxygen with carbon or other fuel, with the production of heat and the presence of flame or smouldering.

fish.definition: A typically cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills; any vertebrate that is not a tetrapod.

flight.definition: The act of flying; the ability to fly.

focus.definition: A point at which reflected or refracted rays of light converge.

food.definition: Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life.

foot.definition: A biological structure found in many animals that is used for locomotion and that is frequently a separate organ at the terminal part of the leg.

frog.definition: Any of a class of small tailless amphibians of the order Anura that typically hop.

fugue.definition: A contrapuntal piece of music wherein a particular melody is played in a number of voices, each voice introduced in turn by playing the melody.

gene.definition: A theoretical unit of heredity of living organisms which may take several values and (in principle) predetermines a precise trait of an organism's form (phenotype), such as hair color.

general.definition: The holder of a senior military title, originally designating the commander of an army and now a specific rank falling under field marshal (in the British army) and below general of the army or general of the air force in the US army and air forces.

genre.definition: A kind; a stylistic category or sort, especially of literature or other artworks.

glia.definition: The network of glial cells that supports nervous system tissue.

god.definition: A deity or supreme being; a supernatural, typically immortal, being with superior powers, to which personhood is attributed.

gold.definition: A heavy yellow elemental metal of great value, with atomic number 79.

greek.definition: Alternative letter-case form of Greek (“nonsense writing or talk; gibberish”).

grinding.definition: The action of grinding together or crushing into small particles; the sound of this action.

gyrus.definition: A fold or ridge on the cerebral cortex of the brain.

hair.definition: A pigmented filament of keratin which grows from a follicle on the skin of humans and other mammals.

hearing.definition: The sense used to perceive sound.

hedge.definition: A thicket of bushes or other shrubbery, especially one planted as a fence between two portions of land, or to separate the parts of a garden.

heme.definition: The component of hemoglobin (and other hemoproteins) responsible for binding oxygen. It consists of an iron ion that binds oxygen and a porphyrin ring that binds the globin molecules; one molecule binds one molecule of oxygen.

herb.definition: A plant whose stem is not woody and does not persist beyond each growing season.

hilum.definition: The eye of a bean or other seed, or the center of that eye; the mark or scar at the point of attachment of an ovule or seed to its base or support.

horse.definition: A hoofed mammal, Equus ferus caballus, often used throughout history for riding and draft work.

hour.definition: A unit of time of one twenty-fourth of a day (sixty minutes).

human.definition: A highly intelligent ape with fine and short body hair; the most abundant species of primate, with members found on every continent (Homo sapiens).

humus.definition: A large group of natural organic compounds, found in the soil, formed from the chemical and biological decomposition of plant and animal residues and from the synthetic activity of microorganisms.

hyperlink.definition: Some text or a graphic in an electronic document that can be activated to display another document or trigger an action.

idea.definition: An abstract archetype of a given thing, compared to which real-life examples are seen as imperfect approximations; pure essence, as opposed to actual examples.

ileum.definition: The last, and usually the longest, division of the small intestine; the part between the jejunum and large intestine.

ilium.definition: The upper and widest of the three bones that make up each side of the hipbone.

imide.definition: a form of amide in which the nitrogen atom is attached to two carbonyl groups - R1CONHCOR2

inca.definition: Any of several species of hummingbirds in the genus Coeligena

indium.definition: A chemical element (symbol In) with an atomic number of 49: a soft silvery-white metal.

individual.definition: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.

inhabitant.definition: Someone or thing who lives in a place.

injury.definition: Damage to the body of a living thing.

integer.definition: A number that is not a fraction; an element of the infinite and numerable set .

intellectual.definition: An intelligent, learned person, especially one who discourses about learned matters.

iodine.definition: A chemical element (symbol: I) with an atomic number of 53; one of the halogens.

ion.definition: An atom or group of atoms bearing an electrical charge, such as the sodium and chlorine atoms in a salt solution.

java.definition: A blend of coffee imported from the island of Java.

jugum.definition: A connecting ridge or projection, especially on a bone.

jurisdiction.definition: The power, right, or authority to interpret and apply the law.

keynote.definition: A speech that sets the main theme of a conference or other gathering; a keynote speech or keynote address.

kidney.definition: An organ in the body that filters the blood, producing urine.

kind.definition: A type, race or category; a group of entities that have common characteristics such that they may be grouped together.

language.definition: A body of words, and set of methods of combining them (called a grammar), understood by a community and used as a form of communication.

large.definition: An old musical note, equal to two longas, four breves, or eight semibreves.

lava.definition: The molten rock ejected by a volcano from a vent such as a crater or fissure; magma that has breached the surface of the earth.

law.definition: The body of binding rules and regulations, customs, and standards established in a community by its legislative and judicial authorities.

leuco dye.definition: Any dye that has a leuco form.

life.definition: The state of organisms preceding their death, characterized by biological processes such as metabolism and reproduction and distinguishing them from inanimate objects; the state of being alive and living.

lizard.definition: Any reptile of the order Squamata that is not a snake or mosasaur—typically characterised by a rounded torso, a short neck with an elevated head, a long tail and four limbs, although some species are legless.

lobe.definition: Any projection or division, especially one of a somewhat rounded form.

locality.definition: The fact or quality of having a position in space.

lore.definition: All the facts and traditions about a particular subject that have been accumulated over time through education or experience.

lysin.definition: any substance or antibody that can cause the destruction (by lysis) of blood cells, bacteria etc

lysis.definition: A plinth or step above the cornice of the podium in an ancient temple.

malt.definition: Malted grain (sprouted grain) (usually barley), used in brewing and otherwise.

marl.definition: A mixed earthy substance, consisting of carbonate of lime, clay, and possibly sand, in very variable proportions, and accordingly designated as calcareous, clayey, or sandy.

matins.definition: Together with lauds, the earliest of the canonical hours; traditionally prayed at sunrise or earlier.

meat.definition: The flesh (muscle tissue) of a killed animal used as food.

medicine.definition: A substance which specifically promotes healing when ingested or consumed in some way; a pharmaceutical drug.

meson.definition: The mesial plane dividing the body into similar right and left halves.

mint.definition: A building or institution where money (originally, only coins) is produced under government licence.

mode.definition: A particular means of accomplishing something.

monarch.definition: The ruler of an absolute monarchy or the head of state of a constitutional monarchy.

mood.definition: A mental or emotional state, composure.

moon.definition: Any natural satellite of a planet.

moral.definition: The ethical significance or practical lesson.

morocco.definition: A soft leather, made from goatskin, used especially in bookbinding.

mucic acid.definition: A dicarboxylic acid, HOOC-(CHOH)4-COOH, produced by the oxidation of the milk sugar galactose, used as a test for the presence of galactose or lactose.

mud.definition: A mixture of water and soil or fine grained sediment.

musical.definition: A stage performance, show or film that involves singing, dancing and musical numbers performed by the cast as well as acting.

myth.definition: A traditional story which embodies a belief regarding some fact or phenomenon of experience, and in which often the forces of nature and of the soul are personified; a sacred narrative regarding a god, a hero, the origin of the world or of a people, etc.

nature.definition: The way things are, the totality of all things in the physical universe and their order, especially the physical world in contrast to spiritual realms and flora and fauna as distinct from human conventions, art, and technology.

navy.definition: A country's entire maritime military force, including ships and personnel.

near.definition: The left side of a horse or of a team of horses pulling a carriage etc.

nerve.definition: A bundle of neurons with their connective tissue sheaths, blood vessels and lymphatics.

nest.definition: A structure built by a bird as a place to incubate eggs and rear young.

nobility.definition: A noble or privileged social class, historically accompanied by a hereditary title; aristocracy.

node.definition: A knot, knob, protuberance or swelling.

nose.definition: A protuberance on the face housing the nostrils, which are used to breathe or smell.

oat.definition: Widely cultivated cereal grass, typically Avena sativa.

occurring.definition: An instance of something occurring; an event or happening.

ocean.definition: One of the large bodies of water separating the continents.

ohm.definition: In the International System of Units, the derived unit of electrical resistance; the electrical resistance of a device across which a potential difference of one volt causes a current of one ampere.

on.definition: In the Japanese language, a pronunciation, or reading, of a kanji character that was originally based on the character's pronunciation in Chinese, contrasted with kun.

onion.definition: A monocotyledonous plant (Allium cepa), allied to garlic, used as vegetable and spice.

optics.definition: The physics of light and vision: basic optical science.

orgy.definition: A secret rite or ceremony, typically involving riotous and dissolute behavior, including dancing, drunkenness and indiscriminate sexual activity, undertaken in honor of various pagan gods or goddesses (such as Attis, Bacchus, Ceres, Dionysus, Osiris, etc).

osmium.definition: A chemical element (symbol Os) with atomic number 76: a hard, brittle, heavy, bluish-white transition metal found as a trace element in alloys, mostly in platinum ores.

ovism.definition: The belief that the ovum holds all material needed for the development of the embryo.

palace.definition: Official residence of a head of state or other dignitary, especially in a monarchical or imperial governmental system.

palm.definition: Any of various evergreen trees from the family Palmae or Arecaceae, which are mainly found in the tropics.

part.definition: A portion; a component. A fraction of a whole.

particular.definition: A small individual part of something larger; a detail, a point.

partner.definition: Either of a pair of people or things that belong together.

past.definition: The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.

people.definition: plural of person: a body of persons considered generally or collectively; a group of two or more persons.

peoples.definition: plural of people (“a race, group or nationality”)

person.definition: An individual who has been granted personhood; usually a human being.

pharmaceutical.definition: A pharmaceutical or pharmacological preparation or product; a drug.

pin.definition: A needle without an eye (usually) made of drawn-out steel wire with one end sharpened and the other flattened or rounded into a head, used for fastening.

pine.definition: Any coniferous tree of the genus Pinus.

plant.definition: An organism that is not an animal, especially an organism capable of photosynthesis, and typically a small or herbaceous organism of this kind, rather than a tree.

play.definition: Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.

pod.definition: A self-contained unit, container, or enclosure that holds, protects, or transports something. A seed case for legumes (e.g. peas, beans, peppers); a seedpod.

poetry.definition: Literature composed in verse or language exhibiting conscious attention to patterns and rhythm.

ponce.definition: A man living off another's earnings, especially a woman's. Synonym of kept man. Synonym of pimp, especially one hired by a prostitute as a tout, bodyguard, and driver.

population.definition: The people living within a political or geographical boundary.

pore.definition: A tiny opening in the skin.

principle.definition: A fundamental assumption, fundamental law or guiding belief.

prior.definition: A prior probability distribution, that is, one determined without knowledge of the occurrence of other events that bear on it, before additional data is collected.

profession.definition: A declaration of faith. A promise or vow made on entering a religious order.

prophet.definition: Someone who speaks by divine inspiration.

publication.definition: The act of publishing printed or other matter.

pudendum.definition: External genital organs in a human; especially a woman's vulva.

punishment.definition: The act (action) or process of punishing, imposing and/or applying a sanction, typically by an authority or a person in authority (for example: a parent or teacher), especially when disappointed or dissatisfied with the behavior or actions of a child, student, or someone else being looked after.

punk.definition: One who engages in sexual intercourse, particularly: A female prostitute.

pupa.definition: Used as a specific epithet; resembling an insect in its pupal stage of development.

pyre.definition: A funeral pile; a combustible heap on which corpses are burned.

quantity.definition: A fundamental, generic term used when referring to the measurement (count, amount) of a scalar, vector, number of items or to some other way of denominating the value of a collection or group of items.

rabies.definition: An infectious disease caused by species of Lyssavirus that causes acute encephalitis in warm-blooded animals and people, characterised by abnormal behaviour such as biting, excitement, aggressiveness, and dementia, followed by paralysis and death.

racial.definition: A skill possessed by all characters of a certain race.

region.definition: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a country; a district; in a broad sense, a place without special reference to location or extent but viewed as an entity for geographical, social or cultural reasons.

relating.definition: The act of relating, or forming or identifying relationships; relation.

religion.definition: Belief in a spiritual or metaphysical reality (often including at least one deity), accompanied by practices or rituals pertaining to the belief.

resembling.definition: The action of the verb to resemble.

rib.definition: Any of a series of long curved bones occurring in 12 pairs in humans and other animals and extending from the spine to or toward the sternum.

right.definition: That which complies with justice, law or reason.

rota.definition: A schedule that allocates some task, responsibility or (rarely) privilege between a set of people according to a (possibly periodic) calendar.

royal.definition: A royal person; a member of a royal family.

royalty.definition: The rank, status, power or authority of a monarch.

rug.definition: A partial covering for a floor.

ruler.definition: A (usually rigid), flat, rectangular measuring or drawing device with graduations in units of measurement; a straightedge with markings.

run.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.

rut.definition: Sexual desire in any of many mammals, often specific to mating season; the state or season in which this is experienced.

sedge.definition: Any plant of the family Cyperaceae. Any plant of the genus Carex, the true sedges; perennial herbs with triangular jointless stems, a spiked inflorescence, and long grass-like leaves which are usually rough on the margins and midrib.

seizure.definition: senses related to possession The act of taking possession, as by force or right of law.

sense.definition: Any of the manners by which living beings perceive the physical world: for humans sight, smell, hearing, touch, taste.

sepia.definition: A dark brown pigment made from the secretions of the cuttlefish.

sere.definition: A natural succession community of organisms in an ecosystem, especially a series of communities succeeding one another from a time when habitat is unoccupied or disturbed to the time when a climax community is achieved.

sexual.definition: A species which reproduces by sexual rather than asexual reproduction, or a member of such a species.

shale.definition: A shell, scale or husk; a cod or pod.

ship.definition: A water-borne vessel generally larger than a boat.

sight.definition: The sense or faculty by which objects are perceived through the agency of light; the sense by which we see.

similar.definition: That which is similar to, or resembles, something else, as in quality, form, etc.

sky.definition: The atmosphere above a given point, especially as visible from the surface of the Earth as the place where the sun, moon, stars, and clouds are seen.

slime.definition: Soft, moist earth or clay, having an adhesive quality; viscous mud; any substance of a dirty nature, that is moist, soft, and adhesive; bitumen; mud containing metallic ore, obtained in the preparatory dressing.

sodium.definition: The chemical element (symbol Na) with an atomic number of 11 and atomic weight of 22.990. It is a soft, waxy, silvery, reactive alkali metal that is never found unbound in nature. An atom of this element.

software.definition: Encoded computer instructions, usually modifiable (unless stored in some form of unalterable memory such as ROM).

solution.definition: A homogeneous mixture, which may be liquid, gas or solid, formed by dissolving one or more substances.

someone.definition: A partially specified but unnamed person.

something.definition: An object whose nature is yet to be defined.

soot.definition: Fine black or dull brown particles of amorphous carbon and tar, produced by the incomplete combustion of coal, oil etc.

sorus.definition: Any reproductive structure, in some lichens and fungi, that produces spores.

sound.definition: A sensation perceived by the ear caused by the vibration of air or some other medium.

speak.definition: Language, jargon, or terminology used uniquely in a particular environment or group.

spice.definition: Aromatic or pungent plant matter (usually dried) used to season or flavor food.

stoic.definition: Proponent of stoicism, a school of thought, from in 300 B.C.E. up to about the time of Marcus Aurelius, who holds that by cultivating an understanding of the logos, or natural law, one can be free of suffering.

stoicism.definition: A school of philosophy popularized during the Roman Empire that emphasized reason as a means of understanding the natural state of things, or logos, and as a means of freeing oneself from emotional distress.

style.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object. A sharp stick used for writing on clay tablets or other surfaces; a stylus; an instrument used to write with ink; a pen. A tool with a sharp point used in engraving; a burin, a graver, a stylet, a stylus. The gnomon or pin of a sundial, the shadow of which indicates the hour. The stalk that connects the stigma(s) to the ovary in a pistil of a flower.

subculture.definition: A portion of a culture distinguished by its customs or other features, often in contrast to the larger mainstream culture.

subgenre.definition: One of several categories within a particular genre.

sun.definition: A star, especially when seen as the centre of any single solar system.

supporting.definition: That which supports something else; a support.

tabes.definition: A kind of slow bodily wasting or emaciating disease, often accompanying a chronic disease. Tabes dorsalis.

talc.definition: Originally a large range of transparent or glistening foliated minerals. Examples include mica, selenite and the hydrated magnesium silicate that the term talc generally has referred to in modern times (see below). Also an item made of such a mineral and depending for its function on the special nature of the mineral (see next). Medieval writers adopted the term from the Arabic.

tension.definition: The condition of being held in a state between two or more forces, which are acting in opposition to each other.

term.definition: That which limits the extent of anything; limit, extremity, bound, boundary, terminus.

texas.definition: The topmost cabin deck on a steamboat.

thin.definition: A loss or tearing of paper from the back of a stamp, although not sufficient to create a complete hole.

thinness.definition: The state or quality of being thin.

tide.definition: The daily fluctuation in the level of the sea caused by the gravitational influence of the moon and the sun.

time.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

tin.definition: A malleable, ductile, metallic element, resistant to corrosion, with atomic number 50 and symbol Sn.

ton.definition: Any of various units of mass, originally notionally equal to the contents of a tun, particularly: The short ton of 2000 pounds (about 907 kg), 20 hundredweights of 100 pounds avoirdupois each. The long ton of 2240 pounds (about 1016 kg), 20 hundredweights of 112 pounds avoirdupois each. The metric ton of 1000 kilograms (about 2205 lb), 10 quintals of 100 kilograms each.

topic.definition: A subject; a theme; a category or general area of interest.

torus.definition: The standard representation of such a space in 3-dimensional Euclidean space: a surface or solid formed by rotating a closed curve, especially a circle, about a line which lies in the same plane but does not intersect it (e.g. like a ring doughnut).

toxin.definition: A toxic substance, specifically a poison produced by the biological processes of organisms.

tree.definition: A perennial woody plant taller and larger than a shrub with a wooden trunk and, at some distance from the ground, having leaves and branches.

true.definition: The state of being in alignment.

tube.definition: Anything that is hollow and cylindrical in shape.

turf.definition: A layer of earth covered with grass; sod.

type.definition: A grouping based on shared characteristics; a class.

ulna.definition: The bone of the forearm that extends from the elbow to the wrist on the side opposite to the thumb, corresponding to the fibula of the hind limb. Also, the corresponding bone in the forelimb of any vertebrate.

unit.definition: Oneness, singularity, seen as a component of a whole number; a magnitude of one.

urea.definition: A water-soluble organic compound, CO(NH2)2, formed by the metabolism of proteins and excreted in the urine.

urn.definition: A vase with a footed base.

uvea.definition: The middle of the three concentric layers that make up the eye; it is pigmented and vascular, and comprises the choroid, the ciliary body, and the iris.

vagus nerve.definition: Either of the tenth pair of cranial nerves which extend from the medulla oblongata down into the abdomen. Branches of these important nerves supply the tongue, larynx, lungs, gut, and heart.

valence.definition: The combining capacity of an atom, functional group, or radical determined by the number of atoms of hydrogen with which it will unite, or the number of electrons that it will gain, lose, or share when it combines with other atoms, etc.

value.definition: The quality that renders something desirable or valuable; worth.

veda.definition: Alternative letter-case form of Veda (“malt loaf bread”).

vegan.definition: A person who does not eat, drink or otherwise consume any animal products

veil.definition: Something hung up or spread out to hide or protect the face, or hide an object from view; usually of gauze, crepe, or similar diaphanous material.

vein.definition: A blood vessel that transports blood from the capillaries back to the heart.

velum.definition: A thin membrane resembling a veil or curtain. The soft palate. A thin membrane partially covering the cluster of sporangia near the leaf base in quillworts and their extinct relatives. A veil-like membrane of immature mushrooms extending from the margin of the cap to the stem and is torn by growth, to reveal the gills. A locomotory and feeding organ provided with cilia found in the larval stage of bivalves. An annular membrane, typically bordering a cavity, especially in certain molluscs, medusae, and other invertebrates. A delicate membrane found on certain protists.

verse.definition: A poetic form with regular meter and a fixed rhyme scheme.

vertigo.definition: A sensation of whirling and loss of balance, caused by looking down from a great height or by disease affecting the inner ear.

vessel.definition: A craft for transportation on or in water, air, or space. Any craft designed for transportation on or in water, such as a ship, boat, or submarine.

virus.definition: A submicroscopic, non-cellular structure that consists of a core of DNA or RNA surrounded by a protein coat, that requires a living host cell to replicate, and that sometimes causes disease in the host organism (such agents are often classed as nonliving infectious particles and less often as microorganisms).

voice.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.

wall.definition: A rampart of earth, stones etc. built up for defensive purposes.

water.definition: An inorganic compound (of molecular formula H2O) found at room temperature and pressure as a clear liquid; it is present naturally as rain, and found in rivers, lakes and seas; its solid form is ice and its gaseous form is steam.

wax.definition: Any oily, water-resistant, solid or semisolid substance; normally long-chain hydrocarbons, alcohols or esters.

weed.definition: Any plant unwanted at the place where and at the time when it is growing.

weight.definition: The downwards force an object experiences due to gravity.

wheel.definition: A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines. A steering wheel and its implied control of a vehicle.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wing.definition: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.

written.definition: A rap that was written in advance, as opposed to a freestyle.

xenogender.definition: A non-binary gender that is defined not in relation to male or female but by characteristics connected to a thing or concept.

xylene.definition: Any of a group of three isomeric aromatic hydrocarbons, found in coal and wood tar.

yoga.definition: Any of several Hindu or Buddhist disciplines aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquillity; especially a system of exercises practiced to promote control of the body and mind.

yoke.definition: Senses relating to a frame around the neck. A bar or frame by which two oxen or other draught animals are joined at their necks enabling them to pull a cart, plough, etc.; two draught animals connected by such a yoke; a device attached to a single draught animal for the same purpose. Any of various linking or supporting objects that resembles a yoke (sense 1.1); a crosspiece, a curved bar, etc. A pole carried on the neck and shoulders of a person, used for carrying a pair of buckets, etc., one at each end of the pole; a carrying pole.

yolk.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yoni.definition: The vulva or vagina, or a symbol of them, especially as an object of veneration within certain types of Hinduism, Buddhism, and other cultures.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
